hints.title: Parity Partitioning
hints.text: Allowed operations only swap characters at indices with difference 2, preserving index parity.

hints.title: Even and Odd Independent Checks
hints.text: Indices {0, 2} can swap with each other, and indices {1, 3} can swap with each other.

hints.title: Multiset Comparison
hints.text: The strings can be made equal if and only if sorted characters at {0, 2} match between s1 and s2, and sorted characters at {1, 3} match.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of string fixed at 4
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Length is fixed at 4, so direct parity comparison is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that operations preserve odd and even index equivalence classes.
